boundary.lots: Python Engine Core checks every choice within this small declared grid. Optimality applies within this grid only. General nonconvex problems need separate proof.
boundary.paths: Python Engine Core reruns each minute-execution account independently and reads its feedback. These synthetic paths add no independent real-market samples.
boundary.risk: Engine Core checks financial checkpoints, restrictions and allocation. Platform supplies descriptive risk analysis. These are synthetic acceptance cases. Runtime process recovery needs separate evidence. Executable liquidation remains unverified.
boundary.selection: The public null-signal generator retains six finite teaching trials. PBO, CSCV and real out-of-sample results remain unavailable.
